headline: Why these grooves make your car suddenly shake
hook_visual: A car tire crosses real recessed road grooves and visibly oscillates

evidence.claim: Rumble strips alert drivers using noise and vehicle vibration when tires cross grooves

shots.visual_proof: Wheel rolls across multiple recessed grooves in the pavement
shots.mechanism_change: The tire and suspension body move vertically as each groove is crossed
shots.narration_en: Those grooves are designed to wake up a drifting driver.

shots.visual_proof: Contact zone highlights repeated pockets directly beneath rolling tire
shots.mechanism_change: Rolling tire traverses a sequence of shallow pavement grooves
shots.narration_en: Each groove creates noise and vibration that can alert the driver.
